---
title: "Measurement distributions"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    code-fold: true
---

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

triggerR <- new.env()
walk(c("R/read_data.R", "R/remove_future_observations.R"),
     ~ source(.x, local = triggerR))

if (!exists("trigger_5min_mean"))
  trigger_5min_mean <- triggerR$drop_future(
    triggerR$read_5min(format = "long", only_mean = TRUE))
```

## Five-minute distributions

### Overall means 

```{r}
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 18

ggplot(trigger_5min_mean, aes(value, fill = source)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(x = "Five-minute mean", y = "Observed buckets", fill = "Source") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11))
```

### Means by participant

```{r}
#| fig-width: 18
#| fig-height: 40

ggplot(trigger_5min_mean,
       aes(factor(userId), value, fill = source)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(x = "Participant", y = "Five-minute mean", fill = "Source") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 4),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )
```


## Hourly distributions

```{r}
if (!exists("trigger_hour_stats"))
  trigger_hour_stats <- triggerR$drop_future(
    triggerR$read_hourly(format = "long", only_mean = FALSE, min_5min = 4))
```

### Overall means and ranges

```{r}
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 18

walk(c("mean", "delta"), \(stat) {
  p <- trigger_hour_stats |>
    mutate(delta = max - min) |>
    ggplot(aes(.data[[stat]], fill = source)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 60, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
    labs(x = paste("Hourly", stat), y = "Observed hours", fill = "Source") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11)
    )

  print(p)
})
```

### Overall means and ranges by partecipants

```{r}
#| fig-width: 18
#| fig-height: 40

walk(c("mean", "delta"), \(stat) {
  p <- trigger_hour_stats |>
    mutate(delta = max - min) |>
    ggplot(aes(factor(userId), .data[[stat]], fill = source)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
    labs(x = "Participant", y = paste("Hourly", stat), fill = "Source") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 4),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  print(p)
})
```

## Daily distributions

```{r}
if (!exists("trigger_day_stats"))
  trigger_day_stats <- triggerR$drop_future(
    triggerR$read_daily(format = "long", only_mean = FALSE,
                        min_5min = 3, min_hours = 16))
```

### Overall means and ranges

```{r}
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 18

walk(c("mean", "delta"), \(stat) {
  p <- trigger_day_stats |>
    mutate(delta = max - min) |>
    ggplot(aes(.data[[stat]], fill = source)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 60, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
    labs(x = paste("Daily", stat), y = "Observed days", fill = "Source") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11)
    )

  print(p)
})
```

### Overall means and ranges by partecipants

```{r}
#| fig-width: 18
#| fig-height: 40

walk(c("mean", "delta"), \(stat) {
  p <- trigger_day_stats |>
    mutate(delta = max - min) |>
    ggplot(aes(factor(userId), .data[[stat]], fill = source)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
    labs(x = "Participant", y = paste("Daily", stat), fill = "Source") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 4),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  print(p)
})
```
